$comment: Copy to .eagerworks/design-qa-test-cases.json in the target repo and trim to what you need — every field is optional. Normally you don't need to hand-write this: running the skill with no config file triggers a short interactive setup that writes one for you. This file is for a repo that wants to configure it ahead of time, or check it into version control from the start.

extraFocus: Every price and date shown to the user is in the account's currency and timezone, not the org's default
